testCommand: test -s plugins/sdlc-harness/RULES.md || exit 1; test -s plugins/sdlc-harness/PRINCIPLES.md || exit 1; for f in plugins/sdlc-harness/hooks/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done; for f in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json plugins/sdlc-harness/.claude-plugin/plugin.json plugins/sdlc-harness/hooks/hooks.json schema/sdlc.schema.json schema/sdlc.example.json .sdlc-harness/sdlc.json; do node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$f','utf8'))" || exit 1; done; node --test plugins/sdlc-harness/hooks/__tests__/*.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/*.test.mjs || exit 1; echo harness-ok
